title: Never Trust AI With These 3 Things #shorts
description:
Can you trust AI answers? Check these 3 things before you copy anything from Claude, ChatGPT or any AI.

1) Brand-new news: AI models are trained on data up to a certain date, so recent facts can be outdated. Ask where the information comes from and check the source yourself.
2) Numbers & sources: AI can invent a statistic, a book title or a study with total confidence. Verify before you share.
3) Health & money: AI gives general information, not decisions. For anything important, ask a doctor, lawyer or accountant.

Save this video and send it to a friend who trusts everything AI says.
